title: Return & Replacement Policy
content: Most items can be returned within 15 days of delivery (Electronics 10 days, Fashion 30 days, Home 15 days). Wrong, damaged or defective items reported within 30 days of delivery qualify for a free replacement or full refund regardless of category. Return pickup is free and a prepaid return label is generated instantly. Replacements ship once stock is confirmed; if out of stock a full refund is issued to the original payment method.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refunds are issued to the original payment method. UPI and wallet refunds take 2-3 business days, credit/debit cards 5-7 business days, net banking 3-5 business days. Refunds up to Rs 10,000 can be initiated automatically by the support assistant; larger refunds require approval from the Payments team. Duplicate charges are always refunded in full.

title: Payment failed but money was deducted
content: If your payment failed but your bank shows a debit, the amount is usually held by the bank or gateway. We reconcile every failed payment with the gateway: if the payment was captured late the order is confirmed automatically, otherwise an auto-reversal refund is initiated. Banks typically return the money within 5-7 business days. Do not retry with the same UPI app for 30 minutes during an active gateway incident.

title: Workflow: Failed payment with bank debit
steps: Locate the payment for the order
Check gateway status of the payment
Confirm whether the bank debited the customer
Check gateway health for an active incident
Reconcile: confirm order if captured late, otherwise initiate auto-reversal refund
content: Support workflow for failed payments where the customer was debited. Reconcile with the gateway, never ask the customer to pay again before the reconciliation result is known.

title: I was charged twice
content: Duplicate charges happen when a payment request is retried during a network timeout. We detect duplicate captures for the same order and refund the extra amount in full. You keep the order.

title: Workflow: Wrong item delivered
steps: Compare purchased item against warehouse dispatch scan
content: When the dispatch scan confirms a mismatch, replace the item at no cost and schedule a free pickup of the wrong item. If the scan matches the order, escalate to Fulfilment for a photo-based investigation.

title: Workflow: Damaged or defective item
steps: Check policy window (30 days for damage)
Check claim value against Rs 25,000 approval limit
content: Damaged items reported within 30 days are replaced or refunded. Claims above Rs 25,000 (laptops, phones, large appliances) need a quality check by Fulfilment before replacement.

title: Where is my order? Delivery timelines
content: Metro cities receive orders in 2-4 days, other cities in 4-7 days. You can track your order with the AWB number from the courier. If an order is more than 2 days late we expedite it with the courier and add an apology coupon. Premium members get priority dispatch.

title: Order Cancellation Policy
content: Orders can be cancelled free of charge until they are shipped (status placed or packed). Prepaid orders are refunded automatically on cancellation. Shipped orders cannot be cancelled; refuse the delivery or request a return after delivery.

title: How to return an item
content: Open My Orders, choose the item and select Return, or ask the support assistant. A free pickup is scheduled and the refund is processed once the item passes the pickup quality check.

title: Workflow: Unable to login
steps: Check account status (active / locked / security hold)
Check lock status and lock expiry
Unlock account if locked by failed attempts
Suggest clearing app cache / updating app
content: Accounts lock automatically for 30 minutes after 5 failed password attempts. Support can unlock accounts locked by failed attempts and send a reset link. Accounts on security hold must be reviewed by Trust & Safety.

title: Resetting your password
content: We send a one-time reset link to your registered email. The link expires in 30 minutes. Choose a password with at least 10 characters. All other sessions are signed out after a reset.

title: OTP not received
content: OTPs can be delayed by telecom operators. Wait 60 seconds before requesting a new one, check DND settings, and make sure the registered phone number is correct. You can also use the email login link.

title: Nova Plus & Premium membership benefits
content: Nova Plus (Rs 199/month): free delivery and 5% cashback. Nova Premium (Rs 499/month): next-day delivery, 15-minute priority support, extended 30-day returns and NovaFiber speed boost. Upgrades are prorated and take effect immediately after the entitlement sync.

title: Workflow: Subscription paid but not activated
steps: Check subscription payment in payment logs
If retry fails escalate to Engineering with sync error
content: Most activation delays are caused by a failed entitlement sync after successful payment. A sync retry fixes them. Persistent sync failures (ENT-503) need Engineering review; never refund a successful subscription payment as a workaround without approval.

title: Subscription cancellation & renewal
content: Cancelling stops auto-renewal; benefits continue until the end of the current billing period. Expired subscriptions can be reactivated anytime using the saved payment method.

title: Workflow: NovaFiber internet not working
steps: Run remote line diagnostics (signal, ONT status)
If hardware fault detected schedule technician visit
Create service request and notify customer
content: Always check for an active area outage first. If none, run diagnostics; configuration faults clear with a remote reset, hardware faults (weak signal below -75 dBm, ONT down) need a technician visit.

title: Slow internet speed tips
content: Restart your router, use the 5 GHz band near the router, and test speed with a cable. Speeds over Wi-Fi can be 30-50% lower than plan speed through walls.

title: Technician visits
content: Technician visits are free for line and router faults. Slots are 2-hour windows between 9 AM and 7 PM. You receive the technician's name and an OTP to verify the visit.

title: Fraud & unauthorized transaction policy
content: Unauthorized transactions are always handled by Trust & Safety. Support immediately places a protective security hold on the account and saved cards, then escalates. Customers are never asked for OTP, PIN or full card numbers. Report to your bank and the national cybercrime helpline 1930.

title: Data breach & privacy incident response
content: Suspected data exposure is escalated to Security Incident Response within 15 minutes. As a precaution all sessions are revoked and a password reset is enforced. The Data Protection Officer is informed as required by the DPDP Act 2023.

title: Legal notices & data deletion requests
content: Legal notices, consumer-forum complaints and data-deletion (right to erasure) requests are handled only by the Legal & Privacy team. Support acknowledges receipt, creates a ticket and does not make commitments on behalf of the company.

title: Refund status and timelines
content: Track refunds in My Orders > Refunds. Once initiated, refunds take 2-7 business days depending on the payment method. If the ETA has passed, Payments will raise a trace with the bank and share the bank reference number (ARN).

title: Contacting support & support hours
content: The AI assistant is available 24x7 on website chat, WhatsApp, Telegram, email and the mobile app. Human specialists are available 8 AM-10 PM. Premium members receive a response within 15 minutes for high-priority issues.

title: Delivery charges & Cash on Delivery
content: Delivery is free above Rs 499, otherwise Rs 40. Cash on Delivery is available up to Rs 10,000 with a Rs 20 handling fee. Nova Plus and Premium members get free delivery on all orders.

title: Changing delivery address
content: The delivery address can be changed until the order is shipped from My Orders > Change Address. After shipping, contact support and we will request the courier to re-route if possible.

title: Warranty claims
content: Electronics carry a 1-year manufacturer warranty. After the 30-day replacement window, warranty claims are handled by the brand service centre; keep your invoice from My Orders.

title: Coupons and gift cards
content: Only one coupon can be applied per order. Gift card balances never expire and can be combined with any payment method. Apology coupons from support are valid for 60 days.
